mapper.select: SELECT FROM export_artifacts WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND state IN ('READY','ADOPTED') ORDER BY ready_at,artifact_id LIMIT 1
SELECT a.* FROM export_artifacts a JOIN export_tasks t ON t.result_artifact_id=a.artifact_id WHERE t.task_id=#{taskId} AND t.status='SUCCEEDED' AND a.state='ADOPTED'
SELECT FROM export_artifacts WHERE artifact_id=#{artifactId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE export_artifacts SET state='ADOPTED',adopted_by_fence=#{fence} WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND artifact_id=#{artifactId} AND state='READY' AND cleanup_token IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_cleanup_candidates(candidate_id,storage_ref,task_id,owner_id,fence,kind,observed_at,state,cleanup_token) VALUES(#{candidateId},#{storageRef},#{taskId},#{ownerId},#{fence},#{kind},#{observedAt},#{state},#{cleanupToken}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE candidate_id=candidate_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM export_cleanup_candidates WHERE storage_ref=#{ref} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE export_cleanup_candidates SET state='CLEANING',cleanup_token=#{token} WHERE candidate_id=#{id} AND state='OBSERVED'
UPDATE export_cleanup_candidates SET state='CLEANED' WHERE candidate_id=#{id} AND state='CLEANING' AND cleanup_token=#{token}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM export_data_blocks WHERE storage_ref=#{ref}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM export_artifacts WHERE storage_ref=#{ref} AND state IN ('READY','ADOPTED')

SELECT c.* FROM export_cleanup_candidates c WHERE c.state IN ('OBSERVED','CLEANING') AND c.observed_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)-INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM export_data_blocks b WHERE b.storage_ref=c.storage_ref) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM export_artifacts a WHERE a.storage_ref=c.storage_ref AND a.state IN ('READY','ADOPTED')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_execution e WHERE e.task_id=c.task_id AND e.lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND e.attempt_deadline>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (c.fence IS NULL OR c.fence=e.fence)) ORDER BY c.observed_at,c.candidate_id LIMIT #{limit}
